Data Analyst
Pune, Maharashtra, India
2 - 5 Years
Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

● Build dashboards that show the operations team how the robot fleet is performing each week.

● Query the telemetry warehouse with SQL and explain what changed between releases.

● Work with the firmware group to decide which signals are worth collecting next quarter.

● Write short reports that a plant manager can act on without a call to the analytics team.

Requirements:

● Two or more years of analytics work, fluent SQL and one scripting language.
